The name Storm is also a symbol of strength, courage, and resilience.

This can be seen in the X-Men character Storm, who was an integral member of the team and had the power to control the weather. In the African diasporic tradition, the name has also been used to signify resilience and survival, as storms can be both destructive and renewing forces.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Storm holds spiritual significance as it reminds us of God's power and wrath. It is a reminder that just as a storm can bring destruction, God's wrath and judgment can also cleanse and renew. Additionally, Storm can also represent the storms that we face in our own lives, and the faith and trust we must have in God to weather them and come out the other side stronger. The name can be a source of inspiration and encouragement, reminding us of God's power and presence in our lives, even in the midst of turmoil and uncertainty.
